title: Harvest Pipeline Insight
definition: The novel observation that the CADMIES Harvest Pipeline extracts high-level philosophical concepts from conversations.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Think of the CADMIES Harvest Pipeline as a smart robot that reads conversations and finds important ideas. It helps us understand complex topics better.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: The CADMIES Harvest Pipeline uses a combination of keyword search and semantic expansion to identify broad, high-level concepts from conversations. It's a tool for transforming conversations into understandable insights.
difficulty_levels.expert: The CADMIES Harvest Pipeline illustrates a unique approach to extracting philosophical concepts from conversations. It merges text processing techniques with knowledge representation, providing insights that may challenge our traditional understanding of knowledge extraction. Moreover, its open-source nature invites collaborations and extensions to explore its potential in other fields.

extra_fields.insight: The CADMIES Harvest Pipeline extracts high-level philosophical concepts from conversations.
